newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Fortune Cement 1996 net at 516.9 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Fortune Cement 1996 net at 516.9 mln pesos.

text.p: Fortune Cement Corp reported on Thursday its net income in 1996 more than doubled to 516.9 million pesos from 203.4 million pesos in 1995.
The company said it has increased its yearly clinker production to 750,000 metric tons from 500,000 tons with the completion of its rehabiliation programme in November 1996.
It is set to expand its capacity further to 1.8 million metric ton from 750,000 metric tons by July 1997, the company added.
Analysts said the company benefitted from higher capacity and selling prices on the back of a surge in construction activities.
Earlier, the company said it expected its 1996 profit to be 510 million pesos and projected its 1997 net to rise to 1.25 billion pesos.
Fortune Cement is a member of the SM Group of companies owned by Filipino-Chinese department store tycoon Henry Sy.
